description: This file defines the SugarLogger class, a core component for logging within the SuiteCRM system. It provides methods for writing logs, rolling log files, and configuring log settings, and is essential for tracking system events and debugging.

classes.name: SugarLogger
classes.description: Represents the primary logging class for SuiteCRM, providing mechanisms for log message handling, file management, and configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the logger by reading configuration settings and setting up log file parameters.

methods.name: getLogFileNameWithPath
methods.description: Returns the full path to the log file including its filename and extension.

methods.name: getLogFileName
methods.description: Returns the log filename relative to the log directory.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Writes log messages to the log file, optionally including a backtrace if configured.

methods.name: rollLog
methods.description: Performs log rotation based on size or force, renaming old log files and creating a new one.

methods.name: __wakeup
methods.description: Prevents unserialization of the object for security reasons.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the log file handle when the object is destroyed.
